content: what is the matching pattern of MM0 and MM3?

MM0 and MM3 are placed in an interdigitated pattern (ABAB...) in the PMOS row at y = 1.636002. The sequence of fingers from left to right is: MM3_m1, MM0_m1, MM3_m2, MM0_m2, MM3_m3, MM0_m3, MM3_m4, MM0_m4, MM3_m5, MM0_m5, MM3_m6, MM0_m6, MM3_m7, MM0_m7, MM3_m8, MM0_m8.
